body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Pantech(www.pantech.com) introduced Cellphone 'TXT8030' which can be player as well as keypad at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'TXT8030' can be transfer into music player with speaker when rotating full-qwerty keypad under display. It features 2.2-inch display, 1.3 mega pixels camera and Bluetooth stereo.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
